parent.prior_results: Yggdrasil 0/48 all candidates rejected; Wingless unchanged original gamma0 42/48 FP5 FN1; retain negatives; both AR DEV cohorts not consumed

sources.constructor: Same source-born paired graph generator only, rebind NEW independent cohort IDs and hash-derived operators. Do not reuse F124-AR TRAIN or consumed F124-AQ DEV. Exactly 3 corrupted public output demonstrations, 24 matching supports (20 FIT, 4 CHECK), 48 paired cases per lane and source split.
sources.dev_source_construction: FORBIDDEN in TRAIN/source adapter; no DEV execution until new frozen eligible winner and independent preflight.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Train a source-blind error-correcting inverse from paired demonstrations via weighted syndrome-consistency or nonlinear interaction residuals, rather than global shared latent attention or simple threshold relaxation.
Yggdrasil.train: For 16 inverse targets, optimize a regularized linear or quadratic bit representation on FIT demonstrations only, with deterministic robust reweighting and no operator or graph labels. CHECK supports solely for calibration. Use original 7 active+9 retained cells downstream. Count all task matrix, weights, solver bytes separately; no fictitious equal-memory comparison.
Yggdrasil.admission: Exact 48 TRAIN paired graph cases; FP0; positive sensitivity >=1; paired correct strictly greater than strongest legitimate source-blind learned same-source comparator; no source truth into model; stricter total computational and memory costs disclosed. If no winner, retain negative and do not inspect DEV.

Wingless.hypothesis: A single 12-bit retained code/node can be improved by penalizing locally nonunique causal handoffs that survive marginal lookahead, instead of weak global terminal-shift penalties.
Wingless.train: Same source-only normalized TRAIN positive/negative pairs for all candidate arms. Only forward-score evidence, no source operator or ground-truth input. Count extra temporary candidate comparisons and cost.
Wingless.admission: All baseline-accepted 13-15-hop positives preserved individually; FP strictly below gamma0; paired correct no lower than gamma0; no additional retained capacity. If no winner, retain negative and keep DEV unopened.
